examples.target: Honestly, I am under a lot of stress and I sleep badly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: You look exhausted lately. Is everything all right?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Honestly, I am under a lot of stress and I sleep badly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: What time do you usually go to bed?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Often after midnight, because I check my phone for hours.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: That is a bad habit. Try to turn off your screen an hour before bed.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I know, but it is difficult to relax after a long day.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: Why don't you read a book or listen to calm music?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That is a good idea. I used to do that when I was a student.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: Also, a short walk after work can improve your mood a lot.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I will try it. I hope I can sleep better this week.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: Give it two weeks. Habits take time to change.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks for the advice. I feel better just talking about it.
